capabilities.description: Calculate Singapore tax depreciation (Capital Allowances) for plant and machinery under Sections 19, 19A, and Low-Value Asset pooling up to S$30k per YA.
Calculate Singapore Corporate Income Tax (CIT) 17%, Start-Up Tax Exemption (SUTE), Partial Tax Exemption (PTE), and CIT Rebate under the Income Tax Act 1947.
Calculate Singapore Foreign Tax Credit (FTC) claims, Double Taxation Relief (DTR), and FTC Pooling System under Sections 50, 50A, and 50B of the Income Tax Act 1947.
Calculate Enterprise Innovation Scheme (EIS) 400% tax deductions on qualifying R&D, IP, and training up to S$400k cap, including the 20% cash conversion option.
Calculate Singapore Group Relief loss transfer between qualifying corporate group members under Section 37C of the Income Tax Act 1947 with 75% shareholding threshold.
Audit Singapore Goods and Services Tax (GST) compulsory registration liability S$1M threshold and compute net GST 9% filings under Goods and Services Tax Act 1993.
Evaluate Singapore loss carry-forward and carry-back relief under Sections 37 and 37E of the Income Tax Act 1947, enforcing the Shareholding Continuity Test.
Calculate Singapore BEPS 2.0 Pillar Two Domestic Top-up Tax (DTT) and GloBE Effective Tax Rate (ETR) 15% threshold for multinational enterprise groups.
Audit eligibility for Singapore Family Office and Fund Tax Exemption under Sections 13O and 13U of the Income Tax Act 1947 per Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) criteria.
Calculate Singapore Buyer's Stamp Duty (BSD) and Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty (ABSD) up to 65% on residential and commercial property acquisitions per IRAS regulations.
Audit Singapore corporate tax compliance risk, detecting GST F5 vs CIT revenue variance, gross margin anomalies, director loan exposures, and withholding tax deficits.
Audit Singapore corporate tax residency, Central Management and Control (CM&C), Board meeting locus, and Certificate of Residence (CoR) eligibility under the Income Tax Act 1947.
Audit Singapore Transfer Pricing Documentation (TPD) mandatory thresholds, Arm's Length Interquartile Range, and Section 34E 5% statutory surcharge exposures.
Calculate Singapore Withholding Tax (WHT) on cross-border payments under Income Tax Act Sections 45, 45A, and 45D including gross-up absorption formulas.
Calculate Singapore statutory annual leave entitlements (7 to 14 days), MOM pro-rata formulas, and termination unused leave encashment under the Employment Act 1968.
Evaluate Singapore Ministry of Manpower (MOM) COMPASS point-based framework for Employment Pass (EP) applications across 4 foundational criteria and 2 bonus criteria.
Calculate Central Provident Fund (CPF) monthly contributions, Ordinary/Additional Wage caps, Skills Development Levy (SDL), and Self-Help Group deductions under CPF Act 1953.
Audit Singapore employment contracts for notice period symmetry, Section 10 statutory defaults, and common law restraint of trade non-compete enforceability.
Calculate Dependency Ratio Ceiling (DRC), S-Pass sub-DRC headroom, Local Qualifying Salary (LQS) weighting, and Foreign Worker Levy (FWL) under MOM statutory regulations.
Audit Singapore mandatory itemised payslip statutory fields, overtime disclosures, and 2-year record-keeping rules under Section 96A of the Employment Act 1968.
Audit compliance with Singapore Key Employment Terms (KETs) 14 mandatory statutory items under Section 95A of the Employment Act 1968 within 14-day issuance deadline.
Calculate Singapore Government-Paid Maternity Leave (16 weeks) and Paternity Leave (4 weeks) with employer vs government reimbursement caps under the CDCA 2001.

Audit Part IV Employment Act coverage, overtime pay rates (1.5x hourly rate), monthly 72-hour overtime limit, and annual leave statutory schedules under Singapore Ministry of Manpower (MOM) regulations.
Audit Singapore Progressive Wage Model (PWM) baseline wages across 8 sectors and evaluate Local Qualifying Salary (LQS) S$1,600 dependency ratio quota impacts.
Calculate Singapore public holiday compensation (1 extra day's basic pay vs day off in-lieu) and rest day substitution rules under Section 88 Employment Act.
Calculate Singapore retrenchment compensation norms (2 weeks to 1 month per year) and evaluate mandatory MOM retrenchment notification rules under tripartite advisories.
Calculate Singapore statutory outpatient sick leave (up to 14 days) and hospitalisation leave (up to 60 days) tiered by months of service under Section 89 Employment Act.
Audit recruitment ads and HR policies against Singapore Workplace Fairness Legislation (WFA) and TAFEP Tripartite Guidelines across 5 protected characteristics.

Audit ACRA statutory corporate compliance timelines, Annual General Meeting (AGM) and Annual Return (AR) deadlines, late filing penalty ladders, and corporate secretarial mandates under Companies Act 1967.
Audit Company Secretary appointment qualifications under S.171 Companies Act, RORC beneficial ownership register, and corporate governance.
Audit corporate structuring, holding-subsidiary governance, capital injections, and statutory entity registrations under ACRA Companies Act 1967.
Audit director qualifications, ordinarily resident mandates, fiduciary duties, S.148/149 disqualifications, and S.156 conflict disclosures.
Audit trademark registrability, Nice Classification (Classes 1-45), Absolute and Relative Grounds for refusal under IPOS Trade Marks Act.
Draft and audit Non-Disclosure Agreements (Unilateral and Mutual NDAs), trade secret protections, and confidentiality terms under Singapore law.
Audit mandatory data breach notification thresholds (72-hour PDPC deadline), significant harm criteria, and statutory maximum financial penalties under Singapore PDPA 2012.
Draft and audit B2B Master Services Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW), warranties, IP assignment, and payment terms under Singapore law.
Audit Shareholder Agreements (SHA), minority protections, drag-along, tag-along, pre-emption, and deadlock clauses under Singapore Companies Act.
Audit commercial B2B contracts, limitation of liability caps, governing law, indemnities, and SIAC arbitration under Singapore Common Law.
Evaluate Small Company Audit Exemption qualification criteria under the Thirteenth Schedule of the Singapore Companies Act 1967 across standalone and corporate group tiers.
Evaluate company striking-off readiness, zero-balance sheet criteria, IRAS tax clearance, and ACRA Gazette timelines under Section 344A.
Evaluate employment dispute mediation and claim eligibility under TADM and Employment Claims Tribunals (ECT) limits (S$20k/S$30k).
Audit corporate whistleblowing policies, anonymous reporting channels, independent investigation, and anti-retaliation protections under SGX/ACRA.
Compute Cost-Volume-Profit (CVP), Break-Even Point in units/revenue, Contribution Margin Ratio, and Margin of Safety.
Evaluate corporate capital budgeting, Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and Payback Period using SORA hurdle rates.
Model rolling 13-week direct cash flow forecasts, monthly gross/net burn rates, cash runway, and insolvency warning gates.
Calculate trade receivables impairment under SFRS 109 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provision matrix and evaluate IRAS S.14(1)(a) fiscal tax deductibility.
Build integrated 3-statement financial models, dynamic sensitivity tables, scenario projections (Base/Bull/Bear), and corporate valuations.
Compute and evaluate 14 corporate financial ratios across Liquidity, Solvency, Profitability, and Efficiency under SFRS standards.
Structure and audit SFRS 1 financial statements (Comprehensive Income, Financial Position, Cash Flows) with balance check verification.
Model foreign exchange exposure, theoretical forward rates via Interest Rate Parity (IRP), and SFRS 109 / 121 Mark-to-Market (MTM) hedging gains/losses.
Calculate inventory valuation under FIFO, Weighted Average Cost (WAC), and evaluate lower of cost and Net Realisable Value (NRV) per SFRS 2.
Model SFRS 116 lease capitalisation, Right-of-Use (ROU) assets, lease liability amortisation schedules, and short-term exemptions.
Evaluate Singapore Financial Reporting Standards (SFRS for Small Entities vs Full SFRS) and SFRS 115 5-step revenue recognition.
Audit general ledger entries, double-entry bookkeeping reconciliations, and accrual accounting adjustments under SFRS.
Calculate Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) using the Singapore Overnight Rate Average (SORA) benchmark, CAPM cost of equity, and Singapore 17% CIT tax shield.
Model customer-level unit economics, Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), LTV:CAC ratios, and CAC payback periods.
Model 4-tier capital distribution waterfall, hurdle rate preferred return, GP catch-up, and carried interest under Singapore VCC Act 2018.
Calculate Net Working Capital (NWC), short-term solvency ratios (Current, Quick, Cash), and Cash Conversion Cycle (DSO, DIO, DPO) under Singapore Financial Reporting Standards (SFRS).
Audit Singapore industry cluster competitive advantage using VRIO framework, Porter's Five Forces, and statutory regulatory barrier analysis (MAS, HSA, IMDA, MPA).
Evaluate Enterprise Singapore (EnterpriseSG) and IMDA government grant eligibility, 30% local equity condition, and co-funding caps across EDG, PSG, and MRA schemes.
Model Singapore corporate holding efficiency, Section 13(8) Foreign-Sourced Income Exemption (FSIE), Section 13W share disposal safe harbour, and single-tier dividend economics.
Evaluate Singapore market entry vehicles (Subsidiary vs Branch vs Representative Office), Section 10L economic substance, and ASEAN regional FTA expansion routing.
Model macroeconomic and geopolitical stress scenarios on Singapore corporate financials, simulating MAS S$NEER shifts, core inflation, and supply chain friction.
Audit corporate strategic risks and generate an Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) heatmap aligned with the Singapore Code of Corporate Governance 2018 and SGX Listing Rules.
Calculate paid advertising CAC, LTV, ROAS, and the statutory 9% GST imported digital services taxation impact on ad spend in Singapore.
Audit Singapore B2B sales prospecting cadences for PDPA Section 4(4)(d) BCI exemption, DNC Registry compliance, and Spam Control Act 2007 requirements.
Formulate Singapore brand positioning coordinates, Singapore Trust & Brand Equity Index, and defensibility against regional market competitors.
Audit Singapore B2B/B2C marketing copy against ASAS advertising standards, prohibited superlative claims, and colloquial Singlish brand appropriateness.
Score Singapore B2B prospective accounts using ACRA paid-up capital, IRAS GST registration status, SSIC industry cluster priority, and BANT criteria.
Audit Singapore hyper-local SEO signals, ccTLD (.sg/.com.sg) priority, ACRA UEN Schema.org markup, 6-digit postal codes, and commercial hub geo-intent.
Model multi-platform social media campaign budgets, influencer tiers, and optimal Singapore commuter peak timing (SGT) across LinkedIn, IG, and TikTok.
